intervention: Only the complete KnowledgeLibrary differs: the measured producer library versus its empty pre-production state. Both arms inherit identical paid consumer and producer reports, observations, completed source research and resource limits. Fork before the native scheduler proposes a revisit; no queued candidate is supplied.
fixture: Existing TemporalInquiryLab task_index=1, finite2. Consumer buys three 24-row trajectories; source invokes the already implemented legacy_research operator. The development case includes meter readings; cohort consumer evidence uses controls only, matching the public predictor contract. The source may purchase measurements.
execution: Controlled offline invocation of the current LLM tools and native session. There is no external LLM or supplied final law; this is a connection study, not autonomous LLM action-selection evidence. Native session decides whether and how to revisit.
accounting: Include the physically shared source production and consumer acquisition once in each counterfactual arm. Add actual screening, revisit and Agent finish charges. Each episode retains its original cap and fresh-confirmation reserve.
evaluation_order: Train every arm in every registered cohort case before any Agent finish confirmation or terminal evaluation. Finish failures are retained without retraining. Evaluate each exported frozen model even if Agent confirmation failed.
scope: Knowledge-triggered continuation versus no available transfer knowledge. The removed arm is the same native scheduler, not a new ordinary-agent baseline. Source return means an actual fresh paired comparison, not method support count.
